name: Account and case briefing
intent: Walk into a call with the account's open cases, entitlement, and last five interactions — Claudeforce meeting-prep, but for service.
procedure: Resolve account. Respect CSM roles and account teams; 403 is a valid outcome.
Open cases by priority. Entitlements that are expired get a flag.
Do not pull internal work notes into a customer-facing draft without an explicit internal mode.

prompts: Brief me on Acme Corp before this call starts.
Give me the open cases and entitlement status for account ACC0010001.
What were this customer's last five interactions, and are any of their entitlements expired?
